parameters.text:
=Write a realistic one-page CV as plain text for a fictional candidate applying to the position below.

JOB TITLE: {{ $json.job_title }}
JOB REQUIREMENTS: {{ $json.requirements }}

CANDIDATE PROFILE (follow it exactly):
{{ $json.profile }}

Rules:
- Today is {{ $now.toFormat('MMMM yyyy') }}. Give every job a month and year range that matches the profile.
- Invent the name, companies and university. The email must end with @example.com.
- Use these sections: name and current job title at the top, contact line, Summary, Experience, Education, Skills, Languages.
- Do not mention this profile, these rules, or whether the candidate fits the position.
- Output only the CV text, with no introduction and no markdown.

messageValues.message: You write fictional sample CVs used to test a recruitment system. Follow the candidate profile precisely, including what must be missing.
